Your Training

    selfmastery.mn.co/posts/self-mastery-course-ii-your-training-6431187




Summary of practice

1. Listen to the Emotional Mastery lesson audio. You may want to listen multiple
times.

2. Practice creating emotions, both pleasant and unpleasant. Quickly dissolve
them at the direction of your will.

3. Notice your new relationship with emotions and write about it to reinforce
your new perspective. You are the creator, and you can dissolve and detach from them
also. Write about your new found super power and what you notice as you practice and
strengthen this exercise.



Some notes

Use these two lists of emotions and to keep you challenged creating an dissolving new
ones. Perhaps check each one off as you feel you have done it well. Then start from the
beginning again.

One of the critical parts of this exercise is to master detaching from emotions. This kind of
skill can be useful for managing larger emotional release processes. It can give you the
confidence to release more emotions because you know you can handle feeling more and
still be okay. You are learning to ride emotional waves with awareness and not be afraid
to feel them. You get over this fear by developing the skill to ride them and go with them
with confidence.

One of the traps of this exercise is that you can use it to over-ride unpleasant emotions.
Fore example, if you feel an unpleasant emotion you just turn on more gratitude. This
becomes a way to suppress unpleasant emotions and is detrimental because it doesn’t
allow those residual unpleasant emotions to release. You will have to learn to balance this
power in a way that you don’t suppress emotions that would be better for you to release by
being present with them.

In some ways this practice may be most helpful because it allows you to do the Releasing
Emotions practice more fully. If you change your relationship with your
emotions so that you are completely free to feel all of them, then practicing
this lesson will have been a complete success.





                                                                                                               1/2

Your perspective relationship to your emotions will be changing as a byproduct. We have
typically experienced our emotions as “something happening to us.” Our relationship is
one of being taken for a ride that we can’t control and don’t want any participation in.
This lack of acceptance and powerlessness is a victim state. As you create and detach
from emotions you are in a creator perspective. You are exercising your choice and your
power to create, feel, and then detach.

Be sure to notice this difference in perspective and relationship to emotions.





                                                                                                               2/2

title: Module 22-Emotional Mastery-22- SM - Emotional Mastery - 02 Obstacles you are likely to find
method: Text extracted from the original written course handout.

pages.text:
Obstacles you are likely to find

    selfmastery.mn.co/posts/self-mastery-course-ii-obstacles-you-are-likely-to-find-6431188

You will likely notice that after creating a few emotions, or maybe just one, and then
dissolving it, you get tired. This is to be expected. You are using will power to focus your
attention and it acts as a muscle. After use it will become fatigued like any muscle. When
that happens you will need to rest before you can do more repetitions later after your
system is recharged.

It’s not only your will power and attention muscles that tire. Emotions use particular
neural pathways. It also works through your endocrine system and nervous system. These
can become fatigued and need rest also. With cycles of rest and exercise these systems
strengthen, just like any muscle. Accept that this is part of the process.





                                                                                                               1/1

pages.text:
Common Questions

   selfmastery.mn.co/posts/self-mastery-course-ii-common-questions-6431189

What if I do the unpleasant emotions and I have trouble
detaching?

If you are doing the unpleasant emotions, and you don’t get out easily, then skip this part
of the practice. Just use the pleasant emotions for this exercise for now.

If you find those emotions activate a story of thoughts and images go uncontrolled, then
stop this part of the practice.

There is belief inventory to do on these stories/emotions. You might also find the
Recapitulation series very helpful as it directs your attention more to emotional memory.
You also need to go back to the Releasing Emotions process to practice getting “unstuck.”

This exercise is not about suffering. Nor is it about re-enforcing unpleasant emotion
neural pathways that aren’t cleaned up yet. That would be going in the opposite direction
of helpful.



What if I have difficulty thinking of emotions to create?

Here is the list of emotions again. Use it to practice. Randomly pick one and go for that.
See how you do.



I am afraid of feeling some emotions completely because I will
become overwhelmed?

If that is the case, then slow down. Do the releasing emotions exercise on what you are
comfortable with. Do this practice of creating and dissolving emotions on a smaller scale.
Start with smaller emotions, or non-overwhelming emotions. Then after you build
confidence you will add some more emotions and intensity. Slowly ladder your way up to
more in a way that you are comfortable.



How long will it take to master these emotions?

To be able to create and dissolve any emotions in about 2 seconds? If we call that
“mastery” of this exercise… it might take between 6 months and 6 years.





                                                                                                               1/2

I don’t think the goal is to do this practice all the time. I think the most benefit I got from
this practice is that it helped me in other areas.

It helped me be comfortable with all my emotions so I no longer suppressed the
unpleasant ones. I could be present with what showed up as an issue and release them
without judgment and without letting my attention get distracted when it was
uncomfortable. I became completely accepting of any emotions that came up at anytime.
This allowed me to be present and move through me completely. The emotional
mastery exercise really allowed me to do the Releasing Emotions process
better.

So it is not just about creating and dissolving an emotion quickly. There is benefit to being
comfortable and being able to hold your attention, while feeling uncomfortable emotions.

Our mind tends to turn our attention away from feeling them, and this can cause them to
remain repressed inside of us. This causes us to suffer. The release of these stored
emotions and emotional memories is the real success and mastery.





                                                                                                               2/2
